independence_evidence: Founder-run London hip hop title describing itself as 'independent journalism' with its own WooCommerce shop and no parent company named (https://www.vipermag.com/shop/, https://www.vipermag.com/product/lil-tjay-viper-magazine-print/).
qualifies_reason: The most recent print issue is Winter 2024 (on sale 23 December 2024); no print issue dated 2025 or later was found, only online features.
what_it_is: Viper is a London-based hip hop and R&B magazine covering UK, US and Caribbean artists through long interviews, cover shoots, new music and style pieces. Print issues appear occasionally as 100-page editions with several collectible covers (the Winter 2024 issue has Lil Tjay, Spice, Skillibeng, SadBoi and Lila Iké), alongside a continuously updated website. It is for rap and dancehall fans who want in-depth artist features.

cover_candidates.notes: Flat front cover artwork, Lil Tjay edition; 4:5 crop at 1080px wide, so slightly under the 1000px-long-edge target only on width.

uncertainties: Print cadence is irregular (AW22, SS23, AW23, W24). The homepage in November 2026 still presents Winter 2024 as the 'latest print issue'; a web search found no 2025 or 2026 print issue, so printed_since_2025 is recorded as no. The 1080x1350 cover file is the largest found on the publisher site.
